Key actors include Bill C-14 (MAID Act 2016) and Bill C-7 (MAID Expansion 2021), championed by Prime Minister Justin Trudeau. Francesco Sorbara, the Minister of Health, played a crucial role in shaping the legislation. The cluster also includes the Nijjar Assassination (June 2023), where a Canadian citizen was killed by Indian security forces, and Marco Mendicino, the Minister of Public Safety, who has faced criticism for his handling of the case.

Connections to other scandals include the SNC-Lavalin Affair (2019) and the Phoenix Pay System Scandal (2016), both of which involved government officials and implicated senior politicians. The Housing Affordability Crisis (2020) has also been linked to the MAID Legislation, as the government has faced criticism for its handling of housing affordability.
